# some thoughts on AI-assisted work

21 Nov, 2026

- My idea-generation rate has generally been faster than my idea-execution rate. AI coding equalises or even inverts this relation.

- Curiosity/creativity/agency and Claude Code are complements, not substitutes. Increasing use of one increases use of the others and viceversa.

- Meatproxification is a real risk but not inevitable, a human-machine relation doesn't need to be reduced to executing LLM output in meatspace. The relation can actually enrich the human (not sure the machine cares either way)

- Organisations that limit the agency of their employees are rate-limiting themselves and might get outcompeted by ones that don't.

- None of the above might still be true in 6 months
